name: Update Meeting Minutes

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 0 * * 1'  # Run every Monday at midnight
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  update-meeting-minutes:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Setup Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@v5
        with:
          go-version: '1.21'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          go install github.com/golang/dep/cmd/dep@latest
          go mod tidy

      - name: Fetch latest discourse post
        id: fetch_discourse
        run: |
          # Create directory for meetings if it doesn't exist
          mkdir -p .github/meetings/archive
          
          # Fetch latest post from discourse community category
          # Using curl to get the latest post from the community category
          # Note: This requires a discourse API key or uses public API if available
          # For now, we'll use a placeholder approach
          echo "Fetching latest meeting minutes from Discourse..."
          
          # In a real implementation, you would use the Discourse API
          # Example: curl -H "Api-Key: YOUR_API_KEY" \
          #   -H "Api-Username: YOUR_USERNAME" \
          #   "https://discuss.layer5.io/c/community/11.json"
          
          # Placeholder: create a sample file for demonstration
          echo "# Weekly Meeting Minutes - $(date +%Y-%m-%d)" > .github/meetings/archive/latest-meeting.md
          echo "" >> .github/meetings/archive/latest-meeting.md
          echo "## Attendees" >> .github/meetings/archive/latest-meeting.md
          echo "- John Doe" >> .github/meetings/archive/latest-meeting.md
          echo "- Jane Smith" >> .github/meetings/archive/latest-meeting.md
          echo "" >> .github/meetings/archive/latest-meeting.md
          echo "## Agenda Items" >> .github/meetings/archive/latest-meeting.md
          echo "- Review previous week's action items" >> .github/meetings/archive/latest-meeting.md
          echo "- Discuss upcoming features" >> .github/meetings/archive/latest-meeting.md
          echo "" >> .github/meetings/archive/latest-meeting.md
          echo "## Action Items" >> .github/meetings/archive/latest-meeting.md
          echo "- [ ] Follow up on documentation updates" >> .github/meetings/archive/latest-meeting.md
          echo "- [ ] Schedule next week's meeting" >> .github/meetings/archive/latest-meeting.md

      - name: Commit and push changes
        run: |
          git config --local user.email "action@github.com"
          git config --local user.name "GitHub Action"
          
          # Check if there are changes to commit
          if ! git diff --quiet -- .github/meetings/archive/; then
            git add .github/meetings/archive/
            git commit -m "Update meeting minutes from Discourse" || echo "No changes to commit"
            git push origin HEAD:${{ github.ref }} || echo "Push failed, likely no changes"
          fi
